topics.access: Login, signup, password or account access
topics.usability: Navigation, controls, layout, queue/playlist management, ad interruptions
topics.playback: Playback failure, crashes, lag, connection failures, audio quality, resource use
topics.downloads: Downloading, saved music, offline listening, disappearing downloads
topics.catalog: Missing songs/artists, search/discovery, recommendations, lyrics availability
topics.billing: Price, charges, subscriptions, paywalls, premium entitlement; explicitly premium-only controls go here
topics.support: Contacting support and the support response
topics.other: General praise/criticism, unrelated content, or no supported specific topic

topic_rule: Choose the problem with the highest supported severity. On a tie choose the first specific problem mentioned. For a positive review choose the first specific praised feature; general praise is other. A paid-plan mention alone is not billing.

intent_definitions.cancellation: Explicitly leaving, uninstalling, cancelling, or threatening to do so
intent_definitions.request: Desired change without a reported failure
intent_definitions.praise: Positive experience without a higher-precedence intent
intent_definitions.unclear: Unrelated/meaningless text or bare boycott slogans without a product complaint or explicit personal departure

severity.1: No reported problem: praise, neutral/unclear content, or a pure feature request
severity.2: Dislike, generic criticism, minor annoyance, or cosmetic issue; no supported functional loss
severity.3: A degraded or restricted function; some use or workaround remains
severity.4: A clearly blocked core task, such as inability to log in or play music
severity.5: Explicit serious financial, privacy, or data harm; an expensive plan, a crash, or angry language alone is insufficient

severity_rule: Stars, angry language and cancellation intent do not establish severity. Missing context triggers needs_review; do not invent impact.

sentiment.evaluation: Report mean absolute error; tolerance 0.25 is a secondary diagnostic.

evidence_quote: Nonempty exact substring of original review text; use the entire original short review initially. Exact membership alone does not prove label support.
entities: Only terms explicitly present in the original text, with case-insensitive literal matching. An empty list is valid.
needs_review: Flag missing context, uncertain language, contradictory labels, or insufficient evidence; this is a prediction to evaluate, not an accuracy guarantee.

synthetic_examples.text: Ads keep interrupting my music, but playback works
My playlist is slow to open but eventually loads
I pay for Premium but all music crashes and will not play
Premium never activated after I subscribed
I am uninstalling because I dislike the new color
